newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares up but below highs ahead of Wall St.
newsitem.headline: French shares up but below highs ahead of Wall St.

text.p: French shares were trading higher but below their highs ahead of the opening on Wall Street, expected to start easier after a long weekend.
Dealers said shares were slightly helped by Prime Minister Alain Juppe's announcement that he would not return to office if the centre-right won the runoff on Sunday.
But the rise was mainly a rebound to Monday's sharp 3.9 percent fall, its biggest one-day fall in more than four years, on the left's unexpected lead in the first round.
At 1323, the blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 0.55 percent at 2669.44 points. Total volume was five billion francs.
